method.probes: Two extra independent health/HIT lanes every >=500ms; not included in load concurrency or throughput.
method.rate: success_rps counts completed 200 within the fixed measurement window; drained_success_rps includes final in-flight drain.
method.same: One initially cold key per scenario, then naturally HIT; jobs exactly 1 across the entire interval. Not sustained cold misses.
method.cold: Different/mixed version segment is unique for every cold request, not an ignored query parameter.
method.decode: Full libvips pixel evaluation once per unique response SHA256 after timing; dimensions/MIME validated; every successful response hashed.
method.rejection_phase: Pool log errors prove pool rejection counts; residual HTTP errors are pre-pool/HTTP/cache, without unsupported exact lock-phase attribution.
method.fixtures_caveat: Original local 300px photographs plus a deliberately enlarged derivative, not genuine native large-photo evidence. No downloaded fixtures.
